in_hebrew.name: Hebel
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Hebel הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. Derived from the Hebrew havel, meaning breath or transience. In the Bible, Hebel is the name of the third son of Adam and Eve, and the name of the first man to die.
